claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of California on April 10, 2026, at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PDT).
NASA's Artemis II splashdown marks the safe return of four astronauts.
NASA's Artemis II mission lasted 10 days.
NASA's Artemis II mission orbited the Moon.
The Orion capsule will land off the coast of San Diego, California.
A Falcon 9 rocket is scheduled to launch from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California around 10:39 p.m. ET (7:39 p.m. PDT) on April 10, 2026.
Vandenberg Space Force Base is roughly 200 miles north of the Artemis II splashdown site
